sloka: तस्याहं हरिणः क्षेत्रे जातो वातेन मैथिलि ।हनुमानिति विख्यातो लोके स्वेनैव कर्मणा ।। ५.३५.८२।।।।
transliteration: tasyāhaṁ hariṇaḥ kṣetre jāto vātena maithili ।hanumāniti vikhyāto loke svenaiva karmaṇā ।। 5.35.82।।।।

translations.english: "O Mythili I was born in that land retrieved by the Windgod. I am known as Hanuman by virtue of my own action.
